sourceTitle: Sermons on the Scriptural Principles of our Protestant Church
description: "Sermons on the Scriptural Principles of our Protestant Church" by Edward Hoare is a religious text written in the mid-19th century. This work consists of a series of sermons that aim to articulate the foundational doctrines of the Protestant Church while addressing theological disagreements with the Roman Catholic Church.
